name: basehalf-ai-video
description: The providers and model catalog of BaseHalf's image and video cards, a starter video workflow, and Sequence playback.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Image and video cards send requests to the providers set up on this computer and write their files into the workspace.

basehalfAgentCapabilities.label: Video Workflow Documents
basehalfAgentCapabilities.description: Describe shots and arrange videos in playback order, without adding another canvas, editor, or renderer.

documents.schemaSummary: A shot.json root object with version 1, kind pointa.basehalf-ai-video.shot, a stable id, a title, and clipNodePath, the path of the shot's video card (.mp4, .mov, .m4v, or .webm), a draft until it generates. clipNodePath is relative to the directory containing that shot.json file.

A video-sequence.json root object with version 1, kind pointa.basehalf-ai-video.sequence, and ordered items. Every item has a unique id, a title, and videoPath, a video file (.mp4, .mov, .m4v, or .webm) relative to the directory containing video-sequence.json; for a video BaseHalf generated, generationId is the id of its made.yaml. An item is available when its path is a video file and, with a generationId, that file's made.yaml has it.

operations.description: Check that every clip names a video file and, with a generationId, the video of that generation, without changing the Sequence.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file in the open local workspace.

returns.description: Validation status and the state of each clip: available, missing, or changed.

operations.description: Append one video card with its file to playback order, with the id of its made.yaml when it has one.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: URI of a video file below the directory containing video-sequence.json.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Unique stable id for the new Sequence item.

returns.description: The add operation, saved item, saved Sequence document, and fresh inspection.

operations.description: Move one clip by one position in playback order.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Stable id of the Sequence item to move.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Move the item one position earlier or later.

returns.description: The saved Sequence document after the move.

operations.description: Remove one clip from playback order and keep its video.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Stable id of the Sequence item to remove.

returns.description: The remove operation, removed item, saved Sequence document, and fresh inspection.

operations.description: Update only the path of one clip after a bounded scan finds exactly one video whose made.yaml has the clip's generationId.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Stable id of the Sequence item whose missing path should be repaired.

returns.description: Fresh Sequence inspection after the explicit path repair.

basehalfCanvasTemplates.description: A brief, a script, and a first shot as ordinary notes, a video draft, and an empty Sequence.
